title: ►► ►►EDIT !  COMPANY WAS CONTACTED AND  WARRANTY WAS IN PLACE.
text:
►► ►►EDIT ! COMPANY WAS CONTACTED AND WARRANTY WAS IN PLACE.. EDIT ►► ►► I have the base of the vacuum detach from the STEM. There are Two wires showing, RED and Black, and I cannot get it to reattach again! I contacted the company and the Repair was made!

Ever have to drag around a dead fat pig??? That's what this vacuum feels like, but so do almost all canister vacuums feel. It is not easy to manipulate canister vacuums, but if you must, drag this one around. It picked up so much crud..... I didn't even know I had that much. Of course part was cat hair, and the other part was the carpet fibers he scratched out.

Granted, the vacuum has all the neat things, attachments, lights, bells and whistles. But, one thing I do like is starting it from the handle! You don't have to keep going back to the dead pig.....ooops, the canister to turn it on. This is great.

And, another great thing to have is the Brush Cleaner! Well, I haven't seen a clean brush. I had to pry off strings and dirt from the brush. Who likes cleaning the brush??? Not Me! So this is an important feature, provided it works. I also like that you can adjust the levels Digitally.

I struggled with this, and have not mastered it. It is never easy using canister vacuum, but this one was more challenging than I expected. I guess if I was vacuuming the Taj Mahal, it might be easy, but a home, with hundred things in the way???

Ok, I did like the Brush attachment. I have wood slat blinds and I used the brush and I could see where I cleaned! However, it won't get it 100% clean, but does a good start.

If you like canister vacuums, this will do the work! If you do not like canister vacuums, try this one anyway..... It is a powerhorse! The BEAST!
